name: mitso-record-app
description: MITSO Record App monorepo: общие команды для backend и frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -k -n back,front -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint:style --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
